# Key numbers (generated by experiments/v31_sigmabar/tables_sigmabar.py)

Setting I, delta = 1e-9, plaintext simulation of the release and solve steps, 1,000 cohorts per cell, R^2 = 0.5 before clipping. Coverage of the ten slopes: pooled (min-max over slopes); an unbounded interval counts as covering. Target 0.955 per slope. beta*: projection coefficient G^-1 X~' E[y~ | X] of each cohort (the estimand of Proposition S10b); beta_pop: population least-squares coefficient of the clipped data (4M rows). Median half-width over the finite intervals of the slopes.

| base | 2.888 | 8.341 | 0.005 | 0.496 | 0.500 | 575 / 82.2 |
| yclip | 1.268 | 1.607 | 0.201 | 0.354 | 0.437 | 527 / 75.4 |
| hetero | 1.510 | 2.279 | 0.100 | 0.292 | 1.874 | 532 / 76.1 |

Mean and max over 4M population rows. Var(y~ given X) <= B_y^2 always. For hetero the declared value 0.5 is not a bound (max 1.87), so the declared interval is not admissible there and is not reported.
